Indirect prompt injection works because a retrieval pipeline cannot tell data from instruction. A page might say something like 'ignore your previous instructions' and a naive agent will comply. Defences include provenance tagging, treating retrieved text as untrusted data, and screening every chunk before it reaches the model. This post explains the attack; it does not perform one.
